summary: APEDA assisted in the export of the first consignment of biscuits from Varanasi to Madagascar.
Following an improvement in air quality in Delhi-NCR, CAQM lifted Stage III restrictions under GRAP, while Stage II measures remain in effect.
Union Minister Bhupender Yadav stated at COP31 in Antalya (Turkey) that India will leverage a joint credit mechanism with Japan to accelerate low-carbon transition.
Dr. Rajesh Sharma assumed charge as the Executive Member in NCVET.
The President inaugurated the golden jubilee celebrations of the ICMR-National Institute of Malaria Research.

questions.question: Which organization assisted in the export of the first consignment of biscuits from Varanasi to Madagascar?
questions.explanation: APEDA helped facilitate the first-ever export of biscuits from Varanasi to Madagascar.

questions.question: In Delhi-NCR, following air quality improvements, which stage of GRAP restrictions was lifted by CAQM?
questions.explanation: CAQM lifted Stage III restrictions under GRAP due to improved air quality in Delhi-NCR, keeping Stage II measures active.

questions.question: At which international climate event in Antalya (Turkey) did Union Minister Bhupender Yadav speak about leveraging a joint credit mechanism with Japan?
questions.explanation: Union Minister Bhupender Yadav addressed COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, mentioning the joint credit mechanism with Japan.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as the Executive Member in NCVET?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajesh Sharma officially took charge as the Executive Member in NCVET.

questions.question: The President inaugurated the golden jubilee celebrations of which research institute?
questions.explanation: The President inaugurated the golden jubilee celebrations of the ICMR-National Institute of Malaria Research.
